blueprint.title: English Paper — Independent School Style

sections.instructions: Read the text twice. Then answer in your own words. Look at the marks next to each question. A question worth more marks wants more from you. Say what you noticed, then say what it does. The last questions are worth the most, so leave yourself time.
Now the writing task. Plan for five minutes first. Check who you are writing as, and what to include. Write in full sentences and paragraphs. Better beats longer — nobody is counting your words.

blueprint.notes: Authored FROM corpus evidence (SCP-E-11/E-12/E-13/E-17). Single cluster here; the dual-cluster variant (contrasting prose plus a complete poem) is supported by the cluster-set model and wants its own blueprint. Technique-dominant: up to 63% of reading marks, tariffs to 12, graduated credit with band descriptors, T5 reachable. Single writing task at 27-43% of marks. Open-response throughout. Types are forward refs to an English registry that does not exist yet.
